job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions using Python and machine learning algorithms to drive business outcomes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas of improvement and implement data-driven decision making processes.
Develop and maintain complex AI models, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in generative AI, applying this knowledge to improve existing systems.

Job Requirements :

8-12 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence Engineering or related field.
Strong proficiency in Python programming language with expertise in machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn or TensorFlow.
Experience working with large datasets to extract insights and build predictive models.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field; Master's degree preferred.
